national.headline: Fatah-3 Missile Test
national.line: The Pakistan Army successfully launched the Fatah-3 supersonic cruise missile, further strengthening its strategic defence capabilities.

national.headline: Reduction in Fuel Prices
national.line: The government lowered petrol and diesel prices by Rs3 per litre each, providing minor relief to the public.

national.headline: ASEAN Secretary General's Visit
national.line: Dr Kao Kim Hourn is on a three-day working visit to Pakistan to bolster regional cooperation and bilateral ties.

national.headline: ICJ Report on Judiciary
national.line: An International Commission of Jurists report claims the recent 26th and 27th Constitutional Amendments have led to systemic judicial capture in Pakistan.

national.headline: Internet Connectivity Issues
national.line: The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority warned of potential internet disruptions following a technical fault in the SMW5 submarine cable.

national.headline: LPG Imports from Abu Dhabi
national.line: Pakistan received its first 15,000-tonne shipment of LPG from Abu Dhabi under a new policy to manage supply shortages.

national.headline: Inquiry into Illegal Mining
national.line: The KP governor formed an eight-member commission to investigate illegal placer gold mining activities within the province.

international.headline: Trilateral Summit in China
international.line: Xi Jinping, Donald Trump, and Vladimir Putin met in Shenzhen for a high-stakes trilateral summit amid concerns regarding global conflicts.

international.headline: New US House Speaker
international.line: Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries as their leader, positioning him to become the first Black speaker of the US House of Representatives.

international.headline: Sentencing in Assassination Plot
international.line: A US court sentenced a Pakistani man to over 27 years in prison for plotting to assassinate President Donald Trump and other politicians.

international.headline: Gaza Conflict Report
international.line: A US oversight board report criticized both Israel and Hamas for failing to honor commitments, leaving the Gaza ceasefire in jeopardy.

international.headline: US-Saudi Nuclear Deal
international.line: The UN nuclear watchdog endorsed a deal allowing the United States to assist Saudi Arabia in developing a civilian nuclear programme.

international.headline: COP31 Climate Negotiations
international.line: Climate negotiators face challenging final talks in Turkiye as disagreements persist over the draft deal's comprehensive demands.

international.headline: Gene-Editing Trial Scandal
international.line: A Chinese scientist was dismissed following a government investigation that revealed he concealed a child's death during a gene-editing trial.
